comment.comment:
The name of an associated company does not have to be included in a coin’s name or ticker. Across the crypto industry, the organization, project, coin, and ticker often have different names:

**Ripple → XRP Ledger → XRP**  
**Input Output → Cardano → ADA**  
**Offchain Labs → Arbitrum → ARB**  
**DFINITY Foundation → Internet Computer → ICP**  
**Interchain Foundation → Cosmos Hub → ATOM**  
**Electric Coin Company → Zcash → ZEC**  
**Web3 Foundation / Parity → Polkadot → DOT**  
**Stellar Development Foundation → Stellar → XLM**  
**Protocol Labs → Filecoin → FIL**  
**Chainlink Labs → Chainlink → LINK**  
**Solana Labs / Foundation → Solana → SOL**  
**Polygon Labs → Polygon → POL**  
**Aptos Labs → Aptos → APT**  
**Uniswap Labs → Uniswap → UNI**  
**Ava Labs → Avalanche → AVAX**  
**Algorand Technologies / Foundation → Algorand → ALGO**  
**Hedera Council → Hedera → HBAR**

Likewise, **AudaCity** is the name of the in-game company, **DacityCoin** is its coin, and **Dacity** is a natural abbreviation. The second coin launched later and still hasn’t been verified on Fomo, so cramming every possible keyword into its name looks more like an attempt to draw attention away from the original.

What is DacityCoin?

On October 15 Rockstar tweeted a trailer. 
https://x.com/RockstarGames/status/2110717537964953810?a=ZX7WXOtWHb9y5lCBDi0&s=20

At 0:54 Is the first time we officially get introduced to DacityCoin & Audacity.

We have already been introduced to Dacity by Cyberleek leaks, their leaks have been NSFW (in game character without clothing) but you can see that they plan to do stunt missions across gta 6 to promote audacity / dacity coin, listen to the entire 5 minute clip. https://x.com/cryptopatty0x/status/2115109136321122466?a=mMKyvFia_NelrR9XcqQ&s=20

Few things: Lucia is seen wearing a AudaCity parachute 
"Quit your job. Sell your house. Move to Audacity."  is the slogan on said Parachute.

 This seems to be a common slogan that we have seen many times throughout the game.

- The parachute mission ends with landing on Audacity logo.

Audacity seems to be The cryptocurrency cult that lives inside of Vice City. It's kind of Rockstar's way of making fun of all the Miami crypto traders. With the City Coin being the currency they use As of November 12th we don't know if there is going to be an official ticker. It seems like everything is pointing towards it just being the City Coin, including the leaks and the official things they've shown the trailers.

In their newest trailer released on November 10th, we see Audacity and Dacity & DacityCoin a few more times. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_yl5ELcmugI

- At 0:05 we see We see dacitycoin on the side of his helmet and the back.
Audacity on the back of his shirt, and Dacity on the front of his jersey.

And from top HimReaper's thesis, i quote "AudaCity is way bigger then anyone can imagine. It is the mysterious crypto cult/promo stunt brand in GTA6. AudaCity is already in the game code, even if Rockstar says nothing players will discover what AudaCity is and talk about it unraveling the mystery naturally through the world's biggest streamers.

AudaCity is the brand everyone will know.
AudaCity is the cult. DacityCoin is their token they use to promote and get people to "Quit your job. Sell your house. Move To AudaCity"
Just like you can't have PENGU without Pudgy Penguins. DacityCoin cannot exist without AudaCity."
